formula: base = sum(dimension/5 * weight); score = base - risk penalty; priority = score * (0.85 + 0.03 * evidence confidence)

countries.name: Taiwan
countries.summary: Rapid population aging and an aging building stock create intertwined household, care and urban-renewal pains, while public systems expose data but still require coordination.

cities.name: Taipei
cities.summary: Old buildings plus old households is the defining opportunity cluster: seismic risk, urban renewal, elevators, long-term care and foreign caregivers.

opportunities.title: Old-building seismic and renewal diagnostic
opportunities.wedge: Combine building age, structure, public renewal programs, seismic review and owner-consensus pathway into a plain-language building action map.
opportunities.buyer: Apartment owner or building committee in an older Taipei building.
opportunities.painMoment: We know the building is old, but do not know whether the right next step is reinforcement, elevator retrofit, dangerous-building renewal or full urban renewal.
opportunities.currentWorkaround: Architects, renewal companies, city offices, building meetings and fragmented program pages.
opportunities.whyNow: Taipei says it has the highest proportion of 30-plus-year-old buildings among Taiwan's six municipalities, alongside earthquake risk and an aging population.
opportunities.firstPaidTest: Charge NT$15,000 for a non-engineering renewal-path diagnostic on five buildings, with structural findings supplied only by licensed professionals.
riskNotes: Structural safety conclusions require licensed engineers.
Owner consensus can create long sales cycles.
opportunities.fitNote: Very strong systems, collective decision and public-program synthesis fit, with engineering partnership mandatory.

evidence.title: Taipei Urban Renewal Office overview
evidence.note: City identifies high old-building share, earthquake risk, aging residents and lack of elevators.

evidence.title: Taipei 2026 renovation packages
evidence.note: Updated packages include elevator, facade and structural-reinforcement pathways.

opportunities.title: Rental contract and subsidy navigator
opportunities.wedge: Check deposit and repair clauses, map dispute options and calculate relevant Taipei rent subsidies for a household.
opportunities.buyer: Taipei renter signing or renewing a lease.
opportunities.painMoment: I do not know whether these terms are normal, what subsidy I qualify for or where to go if the landlord refuses repairs.
opportunities.currentWorkaround: City housing sites, legal-aid channels, landlord negotiation and calculators.
opportunities.whyNow: Taipei maintains multiple rental dispute channels and household-dependent rent support, creating a rule-heavy decision space.
opportunities.firstPaidTest: Offer NT$990 contract and subsidy checks on 50 leases, escalating legal questions.
opportunities.fitNote: Excellent rules, localization, document analysis and workflow UX fit.

evidence.title: Taipei rental dispute services
evidence.note: City lists multiple dispute and legal-help routes.

evidence.title: Taipei rent allowance checkpoint
evidence.note: Household and income conditions determine subsidy levels.

opportunities.title: Long-term-care command center
opportunities.wedge: Turn care needs into a coordinated mix of home service, day care, professional care, transport, respite, meals and accessibility support.
opportunities.buyer: Adult child or spouse caring for an older Taipei resident.
opportunities.painMoment: There are many services, but our family cannot see which combination keeps this person safe while keeping caregivers functional.
opportunities.currentWorkaround: 1966 hotline, care managers, hospitals, family chat and individual providers.
opportunities.whyNow: Taiwan's long-term-care application itself spans many service categories, while Taipei is investing further in long-term-care infrastructure.
opportunities.firstPaidTest: Sell an NT$6,000 family care-plan diagnostic with a qualified care manager reviewing safety-critical recommendations.
riskNotes: Must integrate with public care managers rather than duplicate them.
opportunities.fitNote: Excellent coordination design fit, but care-domain partnership is required.

evidence.title: Taiwan long-term-care application

evidence.title: Taipei 2026 public-private investment plan
evidence.note: Includes long-term-care campuses among major 2026 infrastructure investments.

opportunities.title: Foreign caregiver hiring orchestration
opportunities.wedge: Track eligibility, medical assessment, documents, agency/employer steps and transition into the household in one case workflow.
opportunities.buyer: Family hiring a foreign live-in caregiver for an older or disabled relative.
opportunities.painMoment: Care is urgent, but one missing document or misunderstood eligibility step can delay the person we depend on.
opportunities.currentWorkaround: Broker, hospital, government portals and family paperwork.
opportunities.whyNow: The official process involves multiple eligibility and documentation stages across health and labor systems.
opportunities.firstPaidTest: Partner with a licensed employment-service operator and test an NT$8,000 family-side case dashboard.
opportunities.fitNote: Strong workflow product fit but partnership-heavy domain execution.

evidence.title: Taiwan foreign family caregiver application
evidence.note: Shows multi-step eligibility and documentation requirements.

opportunities.title: Public childcare placement tracker
opportunities.wedge: Track openings, lottery/waitlist status, commute and backup private options for nursery placement.
opportunities.buyer: Taipei parents of infants and toddlers.
opportunities.painMoment: Registration is centralized, but our actual risk is whether a workable place opens before we return to work.
opportunities.currentWorkaround: Public childcare portal, waitlists, provider calls and family backup.
opportunities.whyNow: Public nursery systems expose vacancy and waitlist status, creating data that can support better family planning.
opportunities.firstPaidTest: Test a free tracker with NT$1,500 concierge placement for families with hard return-to-work dates.
riskNotes: Official portal already provides part of the data.
opportunities.fitNote: Very buildable, but weaker economics than building or care opportunities.

opportunities.title: Old-building elevator and repair grant concierge
opportunities.wedge: For low-rise walkups, map elevator/facade/structural program eligibility, owner approvals and application steps into one building proposal.
opportunities.buyer: Older low-rise condominium committee and owners.
opportunities.painMoment: Aging residents cannot manage the stairs, but getting the building to agree on and execute an elevator project feels impossible.
opportunities.currentWorkaround: Building meetings, architects, contractors and city renewal office.
opportunities.whyNow: Taipei's updated 2026 renovation packages explicitly include elevator pathways for old buildings.
